content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The agreement contains two Customer-side sourcing commitments:

1. **§ 10.3(A) (p0183)** — Customer "shall be required to obtain from M&I all of those Services which are included in the Monthly Base Fee" *during the Term*: a full-term sole-supplier obligation with no category/12-month limit and no automatic performance-based exit (walk-away territory).
2. **§ 6.8 (p0121)** — Customer "agrees to use M&I primarily for Customer's Bankcard Services data processing": a majority-sourcing commitment, again unlimited in duration and without a performance exit.

Other "exclusive" hits were checked and are not responsive (Customer's exclusive ownership of Customer Data, exclusive venue, non-exclusive source-code licence, Customer's exclusive responsibility for instructions). § 3 Appointment and § 21.11 Future Acquisitions impose no independent sourcing obligation on Customer.

**Redline (preferred level, validated ok:true):** two surgical sentence replacements making M&I a non-exclusive provider and confirming Customer may use other providers for bankcard processing, preserving the Monthly Base Fee pricing acknowledgment and M&I's service obligations, with the category-limited/12-month/performance-exit fallback offered in the comment.
